status: DRAFT 2026-10-21 (strategic window, at the operator's request; awaiting operator approval). Thresholds are a-priori drafts, to be calibrated when the mass tier is built; never fitted to outcomes.
structure: Same as NBA v4: role archetypes (players are weighted hybrids across them) + cross-cutting modifiers. Each archetype carries group, name, notes, signals, threshold; each modifier name, notes, threshold. GG-### in a threshold = the signal has no free source yet.

HIT-1.name: Power Bat / Damage Hitter
HIT-1.signals: barrel %, hard-hit %, ISO, xSLG, launch angle

HIT-2.name: Contact / Bat-to-Ball Hitter
HIT-2.notes: Puts the ball in play, low strikeouts

HIT-3.name: On-Base / Selective Hitter
HIT-3.signals: BB %, chase %, OBP, pitches per PA

HIT-4.name: Three-True-Outcomes Slugger
HIT-4.notes: HR, BB or K on a large share of PAs

HIT-5.name: Speed / Table-Setter
HIT-5.signals: sprint speed, SB rate, infield-hit rate, OBP
HIT-5.threshold: Sprint speed >= 28.5 ft/s; SB attempts >= 1 per 20 PA

HIT-6.name: Platoon Bat
HIT-6.signals: wOBA vs RHP vs LHP, PA share by hand

HIT-7.name: Line-Drive / Gap Hitter
HIT-7.signals: LD %, doubles rate, spray angle, xBA

HIT-8.name: Low-Leverage Depth Bat
HIT-8.notes: Bench or bottom of the order
HIT-8.threshold: PA share <= 60% of team games; wRC+ <= 90

SP-1.name: Strikeout Ace
SP-1.notes: Misses bats at a high rate
SP-1.signals: K %, whiff %, CSW %, xFIP, stuff metrics

SP-2.name: Command / Weak-Contact Starter
SP-2.notes: Lives on location and soft contact

SP-3.name: Ground-Ball Sinkerballer
SP-3.notes: Keeps the ball on the ground

SP-5.name: Workhorse / Innings Eater
SP-5.signals: IP per start, pitches per start, TTO penalty

SP-6.name: Short Starter / Opener-Bulk
SP-6.signals: IP per start, times through the order

RP-3.name: Matchup Specialist
RP-3.notes: Deployed by batter hand or type

DEF-3.name: Arm / Run-Suppressing Outfielder
DEF-3.threshold: Arm strength top decile at position

M-3.name: Elite Two-Strike Approach
M-3.threshold: K % with two strikes bottom decile

M-5.name: Elite vs Fastball
M-5.threshold: Run value vs fastballs top decile

M-6.name: Breaking-Ball Vulnerable
M-6.threshold: Whiff % vs breaking balls top decile

M-10.name: Elite Spin / Movement
M-10.threshold: Stuff metric or spin/movement top decile

M-11.name: Elite Command
M-11.threshold: Zone-edge rate and walk rate top decile

M-12.name: Deep Arsenal
M-12.threshold: 4+ pitches each >= 10% usage with positive run value

M-17.name: Elite Hold / Running-Game Control
M-17.threshold: SB allowed per opportunity bottom decile

M-19.name: Velocity Decline Flag
M-19.threshold: Fastball velocity down >= 1.5 mph vs prior season

M-22.name: Umpire-Zone Sensitive
M-22.notes: Results swing with the plate umpire's zone

M-23.name: Catcher-Pairing Effect
M-23.threshold: Split by catcher >= 20% on adequate sample

M-24.name: Developmental Upside
M-24.notes: Young player on a steep curve

M-25.name: Veteran Decline
M-25.threshold: Age 33+ with falling bat speed or velocity

M-26.name: High Variance / Streaky
M-26.threshold: sd of rolling wOBA top quartile

M-27.name: Low Variance / Floor
M-27.threshold: sd of rolling wOBA bottom quartile

M-29.name: Specialist: Opener
M-29.notes: Starts and exits after one or two innings
